history.title: Conversation History
history.subtitle: Review and search your past translations.

HELLO.desc: Open palm temple salute (ISL) / formal forehead salute (ASL)

THANK_YOU.desc: Flat hand moving outward and down from chin

PLEASE.desc: Two-hand Namaste folded palms (ISL) / circular chest rub (ASL)

HOW_ARE_YOU.desc: Cupped palms rotating outward with questioning posture

YES.desc: Closed fist nodding up and down vertically

NO.desc: Index finger wagging side-to-side (ISL) / snapping shut (ASL)

HELP.desc: Closed fist on flat palm lifting upward

STOP.desc: Vertical open palm barrier facing forward

WATER.desc: Cupped hand near mouth (ISL) / W-handshape at chin (ASL)

HOME.desc: Two hands forming roof gable inverted V (ISL) / cheek tap (ASL)

FRIEND.desc: Clasped hands in front of chest

NAME.desc: H/U shape tapping chest (ISL) / crossed H-fingers (ASL)

LOVE.desc: Crossed wrists over chest or ILY sign
